items.title: scikit-learn version 1.9 highlights: Array API & GPU support
items.author: Probabl
items.content:
<article>In the first of our short series on scikit-learn version 1.9, contributor Emily Chen walks through one of the most exciting ongoing efforts in the library: adoption of the Python Array API standard.

The Array API lets scikit-learn run on array libraries beyond NumPy – including PyTorch and CuPy – so you can delegate heavy computation to a GPU without rewriting your pipeline. Emily covers what the standard is, why it matters for everyday model development, which estimators and metrics support it so far, and how to enable it. 

Learn more: https://blog.scikit-learn.org/updates/release-1-9/</article>
